sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Business Process Analysis provides a comprehensive understanding of how current operations function and where inefficiencies exist. It maps workflows, dependencies, and stakeholder interactions to identify improvement areas and performance drivers. Aligned with the ACE model and 6D methodology, it structures analysis around clear objectives and measurable outcomes. Tailored for experienced consultants, it establishes a fact-based foundation for transformation initiatives, ensuring consistency, transparency, and alignment across business and IT.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Delivers insight into operational performance, enabling data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency, agility, and service quality. It strengthens alignment between business goals and execution, reduces risks through clarity, and provides a solid baseline for continuous improvement and scalability.
